original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚卡诺州警方解救被绑架的APC主席
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚卡诺州警方在该州Rogo地方政府区解救了被绑架的全体进步大会党（APC）主席阿卜杜拉希·贝利，其已被关押68天。州长阿巴·卡比尔·优素福对警方行动表示赞扬。贝利此前被武装人员从其位于Rogo地方政府区Beli社区的住所绑架。目前该消息为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Rogo Local Government Area, Kano State

key_facts.fact: 卡诺州警方解救了被绑架68天的APC主席阿卜杜拉希·贝利
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Kano State Police Command has rescued the All Progressives Congress Chairman in Rogo Local Government Area, Abdullahi Beli, popularly known as Abdullahi Fanka, after 68 days in captivity.

key_facts.fact: 贝利被武装人员从其位于Rogo地方政府区Beli社区的住所绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Beli was abducted by armed men from his residence in Beli community, Rogo Local Government Area.

key_facts.fact: 卡诺州州长优素福赞扬警方促成该党主席获释
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf commended the police command, led by Commissioner of Police Adamu Bakori, for securing the release of the party chairman.

uncertainties: 目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
绑架者身份及动机未获确认
获释具体过程与条件未获说明
